abstract_zh.source_value: 针对受限空间火灾中火焰亮度低、目标小、易受干扰等问题,在YOLOv11n模型基础上,提出一种改进的受限空间火灾探测模型SBR-YOLOv11n。在骨干网络部分,将部分标准卷积层替换为空间深度转换卷积(SPDConv)层,解决模型在低亮度下火焰特征容易丢失的问题;在颈部网络部分,引入双向特征金字塔网络(BiFPN)模块,通过双向连接与可学习权重机制提升小目标火焰特征的融合效果;此外,采用倒置残差块注意力机制(iRMB),对动态火焰特征进行自适应加权,提高模型探测动态火焰的鲁棒性。结果表明:SBR-YOLOv11n模型各项评价指标达到最优,与YOLOv11n模型相比,精确率(P)、召回率(R)、平均精度均值(mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95)分别提升5.27%、3.81%、4.17%和3.03%,达到84.94%、83.83%、84.63%和62.97%,检测帧数(FPS)为75 帧/s。SBR-YOLOv11n模型满足受限空间火灾快速与精准探测需求,适用于受限空间火灾探测。

abstract_en.source_value: Aiming at the problems of low flame brightness, small target and easy interference in confined space fires, an improved confined space fire detection model SBR-YOLOv11n was proposed based on YOLOv11n model. In the backbone network part, some standard convolution layers were replaced by Space to Depth Convolution (SPDConv) layers to solve the problem that the flame features were easy to lose under low brightness. In the neck network part, the Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) module was introduced to improve the fusion effect of small target flame features through bidirectional connections and learnable weight mechanisms. In addition, the Inverted Residual Mobile Block (iRMB) was used to adaptively weight the dynamic flame features to improve the robustness of the model to dynamic flame detection. Experimental results show that the SBR-YOLOv11n model has the best evaluation indexes. Compared with the YOLOv11n model, Precision (P), Recall (R), mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5) and mAP@0.5:0.95 are increase by 5.27 %, 3.81 %, 4.17 % and 3.03 % respectively, reaching 84.94 %, 83.83 %, 84.63 % and 62.97 %, with a detection speed of 75 Frames Per Second (FPS). The SBR-YOLOv11n model meets the needs of rapid and accurate fire detection in confined space and is suitable for fire detection in confined spaces.

abstract_zh.source_value: 为了有效防控露天开采产生粉尘的扩散问题，降低粉尘扩散对作业人员健康与周边生态环境的威胁，有力支撑露天矿山绿色转型，首先，系统梳理了不同生产工序条件下粉尘差异化扩散特性方面的研究进展；然后，总结了露天开放环境中风流、湿度、温度等气象条件对粉尘扩散的作用；最后，基于当前研究的局限性，展望了露天粉尘扩散机理研究的发展趋势。结果表明：现场实测受环境扰动影响显著，实验室试验和数值模拟常因过度简化而难以真实反映实际工况；针对呼吸性粉尘的扩散动力学行为及多因素耦合机制的研究尚待深入。未来应致力于研发大尺度、高精度数值仿真平台，构建多参数协同的粉尘连续监测体系，发展基于人工智能的粉尘质量浓度预测与智能预警方法，探究气象与地形条件对呼吸性粉尘迁移的耦合作用机制。

abstract.source_value: 为了有效防控露天开采产生粉尘的扩散问题，降低粉尘扩散对作业人员健康与周边生态环境的威胁，有力支撑露天矿山绿色转型，首先，系统梳理了不同生产工序条件下粉尘差异化扩散特性方面的研究进展；然后，总结了露天开放环境中风流、湿度、温度等气象条件对粉尘扩散的作用；最后，基于当前研究的局限性，展望了露天粉尘扩散机理研究的发展趋势。结果表明：现场实测受环境扰动影响显著，实验室试验和数值模拟常因过度简化而难以真实反映实际工况；针对呼吸性粉尘的扩散动力学行为及多因素耦合机制的研究尚待深入。未来应致力于研发大尺度、高精度数值仿真平台，构建多参数协同的粉尘连续监测体系，发展基于人工智能的粉尘质量浓度预测与智能预警方法，探究气象与地形条件对呼吸性粉尘迁移的耦合作用机制。

title_en.stored_value: Finite-Time Variable-Gain Control for Parallel Manipulators

abstract_en.stored_value: A finite-time variable-gain control method is proposed for parallel manipulator systems subject to disturbances. By constructing a tracking error system model with tracking errors as state variables, the trajectory tracking problem is converted into a stabilization problem for the tracking error system. The proposed method integrates a finite-time variable-gain extended state observer (ESO) and a finite-time variable-gain sliding mode controller (SMC). The ESO dynamically adjusts its gains based on real-time estimation errors to improve both transient and steady-state estimation performance. Furthermore, considering the time-varying characteristics of the sliding surface, a finite-time variable-gain sliding mode controller with dynamically adjustable gains and exponential terms is designed to enhance both the convergence rate and control accuracy of the parallel manipulator system. Simulation and experi-mental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

abstract_zh.source_value: 为探明温压耦合作用下煤体孔隙结构与瓦斯解吸机制的关联,以鱼卡低渗烟煤为研究对象,结合低温氮气吸附、压汞实验、分形理论与Katz-Thompson模型,量化不同温压耦合条件下的孔隙结构与渗透率特征,并开展瓦斯解吸测试。研究结果表明:温压耦合作用下的孔隙响应具有阶段性特征。随着处理温度升高,3组压力下煤样的平均孔径增大,孔容和比表面积占比出现吸附孔衰减、渗流孔增大,总比表面积降低73.5%～87.1%,渗流孔分形维数下降3.3%～4.0%,累积解吸量和初始解吸速度分别增大28.9%～41.0%和37.3%～43.9%,其中2 MPa组煤样总孔容降低10.4%,Kseep提高20.3%,Ktotal降低14.5%,呈现出整体孔容减少、局部渗流输运能力增强的特征; 证明高压压缩并不必然导致多尺度孔隙的输运能力同步下降。研究结果可为解释带压热处理后煤样的孔隙变化与恒温解吸行为提供参考。

abstract_en.source_value: In order to explore the relationship between coal pore structure and gas desorption mechanism under the temperature and pressure coupling,this paper takes Yuka low permeability bituminous coal as the research object,and combines low temperature nitrogen adsorption,mercury injection experiment,fractal theory and Katz-Thompson model to quantify the pore structure and permeability characteristics under different temperature and pressure coupling conditions,and carry out gas desorption test.The results show that the pore response under the action of temperature and pressure coupling has stage characteristics.With the increase of treatment temperature,the average pore size of coal samples under three groups of pressures increases,the proportion of pore volume and specific surface area shows the attenuation of adsorption pore and the increase of seepage pore.The total specific surface area decreases by 73.5%～87.1%,the fractal dimension of seepage pore decreases by 3.3%～4.0%,and the cumulative desorption amount and initial desorption rate increased by 28.9%～41.0% and 37.3%～43.9%,respectively.Among them,the total pore volume of coal samples in 2 MPa group decreases by 10.4%,Kseep increases by 20.3%,and Ktotal decreases by 14.5%,showing the characteristics of overall pore volume reduction and local seepage transport capacity enhancement.It is proved that high pressure compression does not necessarily lead to a simultaneous decrease in the transport capacity of multi-scale pores,which can provide a reference for explaining the pore change and constant temperature desorption behavior of coal samples after pressurized heat treatment.

metadata.abstract_zh: 为探明温压耦合作用下煤体孔隙结构与瓦斯解吸机制的关联,以鱼卡低渗烟煤为研究对象,结合低温氮气吸附、压汞实验、分形理论与Katz-Thompson模型,量化不同温压耦合条件下的孔隙结构与渗透率特征,并开展瓦斯解吸测试。研究结果表明:温压耦合作用下的孔隙响应具有阶段性特征。随着处理温度升高,3组压力下煤样的平均孔径增大,孔容和比表面积占比出现吸附孔衰减、渗流孔增大,总比表面积降低73.5%～87.1%,渗流孔分形维数下降3.3%～4.0%,累积解吸量和初始解吸速度分别增大28.9%～41.0%和37.3%～43.9%,其中2 MPa组煤样总孔容降低10.4%,Kseep提高20.3%,Ktotal降低14.5%,呈现出整体孔容减少、局部渗流输运能力增强的特征; 证明高压压缩并不必然导致多尺度孔隙的输运能力同步下降。研究结果可为解释带压热处理后煤样的孔隙变化与恒温解吸行为提供参考。
metadata.abstract_en: In order to explore the relationship between coal pore structure and gas desorption mechanism under the temperature and pressure coupling,this paper takes Yuka low permeability bituminous coal as the research object,and combines low temperature nitrogen adsorption,mercury injection experiment,fractal theory and Katz-Thompson model to quantify the pore structure and permeability characteristics under different temperature and pressure coupling conditions,and carry out gas desorption test.The results show that the pore response under the action of temperature and pressure coupling has stage characteristics.With the increase of treatment temperature,the average pore size of coal samples under three groups of pressures increases,the proportion of pore volume and specific surface area shows the attenuation of adsorption pore and the increase of seepage pore.The total specific surface area decreases by 73.5%～87.1%,the fractal dimension of seepage pore decreases by 3.3%～4.0%,and the cumulative desorption amount and initial desorption rate increased by 28.9%～41.0% and 37.3%～43.9%,respectively.Among them,the total pore volume of coal samples in 2 MPa group decreases by 10.4%,Kseep increases by 20.3%,and Ktotal decreases by 14.5%,showing the characteristics of overall pore volume reduction and local seepage transport capacity enhancement.It is proved that high pressure compression does not necessarily lead to a simultaneous decrease in the transport capacity of multi-scale pores,which can provide a reference for explaining the pore change and constant temperature desorption behavior of coal samples after pressurized heat treatment.

abstract_zh.source_value: 为提升高海拔复杂地形区滑坡形变识别能力，以青藏高原塘麦村滑坡为例，集成多源监测技术，系统揭示其形变特征及影响因素。基于2020年1月至2024年12月获取的Sentinel-1A影像数据，采用小基线集干涉测量（small baseline subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar,SBAS-InSAR）技术反演地表形变信息，结合全球卫星导航系统（global navigation satellite system,GNSS）监测与无人机（unmanned aerial vehicle,UAV）影像进行交叉验证，并引入气象资料探讨滑坡变形影响机制。结果表明：塘麦村滑坡在雷达视线（line of sight,LOS）方向的年均形变速率范围为-11.67～8.56 mm/a（负值表示沉降），最大累计沉降量达55.61 mm，整体呈持续变形特征；M3与M7监测点形变显著且邻近公路，具有较高失稳风险；SBAS-InSAR与GNSS监测结果一致性良好（r>0.90,RMSE<3 mm）,UAV影像进一步验证了滑坡前缘与后缘的显著变形区。进一步分析表明，在地形地质条件与工程扰动背景下，降雨入渗与气温变化对滑坡变形演化具有一定影响。SBAS-InSAR技术在高海拔强起伏地区表现出良好的适用性，可为青藏高原滑坡监测与风险防控提供技术支撑。

abstract_en.source_value: To improve landslide deformation identification in high-altitude areas with complex terrain, this study takes the Tangmai landslide on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau as a case study and integrates multi-source monitoring techniques to systematically investigate its deformation characteristics and influencing factors. Based on Sentinel-1A image data acquired from January 2020 to December 2024, the small baseline subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar(SBAS-InSAR) technique was applied to retrieve surface deformation information. GNSS monitoring and unmanned aerial vehicle(UAV) imagery were combined for crossvalidation, and meteorological data were introduced to explore the influencing mechanisms of landslide deformation. The results show that the average annual deformation rate in the radar line-of-sight(LOS) direction ranges from-11. 67 to 8. 56 mm/a(negative values indicate subsidence), with a maximum cumulative settlement of 55. 61 mm, indicating a state of continuous deformation. Among the monitoring points, M3 and M7 exhibit pronounced deformation and are located close to the highway, suggesting a relatively high instability risk. The SBAS-InSAR and GNSS monitoring results exhibit good agreement, with correlation coefficients r>0. 90 and RMSE <3 mm. UAV imagery further confirms significant deformation zones at the leading and trailing edges of the landslide. The analysis indicates that under the background of topographic and geological conditions and engineering disturbances, rainfall infiltration and temperature variations have certain influences on the evolution of landslide deformation. The SBAS-InSAR technique demonstrates good applicability in high-altitude areas with strong topographic relief and can provide reliable technical support for landslide monitoring and risk mitigation on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau.
